svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Strike ladder coverage of the 108 basis pairs
svg.text: Each solid rung is one emitted pair. Blue = Kalshi floor, orange = Polymarket floor, exactly one cent apart.
Dashed = a Kalshi rung whose same-hour Polymarket counterpart is not in the capture, so no pair was emitted.
3 listed closes on 2 assets is the whole emitted book for this capture window. Rung spacing is the venues own ladder spacing, not a sample.
Each dashed rung has a same-strike Polymarket contract one hour away, which the hard measurement-instant gate refuses to pair. Those sit in related-pairs.jsonl.
